conditions: Geometrical optics at a stationary interface between ordinary homogeneous isotropic media with positive refractive indices; transmitted propagating ray exists, angles measured from local interface normal.
spoken_aliases: n sub one times sine of theta sub one equals n sub two times sine of theta sub two
incident medium refractive index times sine of the incident angle equals transmitted medium refractive index times sine of the refracted angle

evidence: At a stationary planar interface, phase matching of incident and transmitted monochromatic plane waves along the interface gives k_1 sin(theta_1)=k_2 sin(theta_2). With common frequency and k_j=n_j omega/c, cancel omega/c to obtain Snell's law.
Reference checked 2026-11-27: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-3/pages/1-key-equations. Proposed maintainer approval, not independent human certification.
